newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - MCI sinks after forecast.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - MCI sinks after forecast.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp suffered a steep decline before Friday's U.S. market open, the selloff driven by MCI's forecast of second-half 1997 and 1998 earnings falling under Wall Street expections.
Traders said MCI was actively trading in early third market action as it dropped to 34-1/8 from 42-3/8, the price at Thursday's Nasdaq market close.
In subsequent pre-open trade, MCI stabilized at 34-5/8.
The descent began immediately after MCI made the announcement, pushing the shares down to 40 in Thursday after-hours trade.
